title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - Engineering Controls
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of an **Engineering Control**?
options: Using a Fume Hood when working with volatile chemicals.
questions.explain: A Fume Hood is a physical modification to the workplace that isolates the worker from the hazard (fumes). This classifies it as an Engineering Control. Goggles are PPE; SOPs and training are Administrative Controls.
